goal.summary: MPI-381 is DONE and user-verified live, closed on the board. The mask rail is now Brush / Points / Detect, each mounting only what it needs, plus a B/W mask view in the shared strip. next_action.description: Start MPI-380, the SAM3 masking foundation. Read .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-380/brief.md BEFORE anything else - it holds every measurement and six engine traps that cost real debugging time, including that a -seg model must live in ultralytics/segm/ and not bbox/, and that the SAM3 text field silently returns ONE detection unless the injection writes category:N. Scope is R2 upload plus a dependency entry for sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors, swapping the refiner from SAM 1 to SAM3 on the box path, rewriting the points path onto positive_coords / negative_coords JSON, and deciding the fate of SAM 1 vit_b by grepping every consumer. Do NOT remap the points Scope dial - the SAM3 point path has no threshold, so that dial disappears entirely when this card lands. Offer a plan first; this one is bigger than MPI-381 and touches weights, dependencies and a workflow, so mpi-create-plan at minimum.

key_decisions: BUILD ORDER IS NOW 380 then 382 then 376 then 379, decided by the user this session. 380 first because it rewrites the points path that everything else would otherwise be built against. 382 (grow/shrink) next because it is small, self-contained and cleans up exactly the specks the new B/W view exposes. 376 (undo) before 379 so the payoff feature is protected rather than retrofitted. 379 last, wanting all of it underneath.

MPI-381 SHIPPED THREE TOOLS, NOT FOUR. The card said four, but MPI-368 is a live card owning the entire shapes gizmo (CropManager-derived handles, rotation about a handle, triangle and ellipse hit-tests and rasterisers). Folding it in would have swallowed that card. Shapes becomes the 4th rail entry when 368 ships, and the split makes it a one-line registry addition.

THE PAINT GATE WAS AN ADDITION TO THE PLAN, made deliberately. brush:false only hid the strip controls, so a drag on Detect still painted - the tools would have been split visually while behaving identically. setMaskPaintEnabled() closes that, and it is held on the viewer because the canvas rebuild path re-applies inverted / bwView / pointsMode and would otherwise leave paintEnabled at the manager default.

UNDO RESTEER (user). The original MPI-376 reasoning - a mask is cheap to redo, so paint drives - has EXPIRED. Add and Subtract bake irreversibly into manualCanvas and subtractCanvas, the family is now three tools with a fourth coming, and MPI-382 will rewrite the whole layer in one gesture. Masks are now the primary driver. Kept as ONE card (user choice) so paint plugs into the same stack rather than growing a second one.

GROW/SHRINK MECHANISM, carded but NOT proven live: blur plus an alpha threshold IS a morphological dilate or erode. Canvas2D takes CSS filters so the blur is one line; the threshold needs an inline SVG filter referenced as ctx.filter = url(#id) with feComponentTransfer and feFuncA type=discrete, because contrast() acts on colour and our mask layers are white-on-transparent. Sharp exists server-side (the MPI-362 feather) but is a round trip per drag, so it is the FALLBACK, not the starting point.

Carried forward and still true: mask tools NEVER swap the viewer surface (swapToPreview destroys MpiCanvas as a VRAM optimisation); a tool swap must not clear the mask; any tool that makes a mask outside a brush stroke must emit mask-ready or call viewer.el.evaluateMask() or the op strip never unlocks; the rail owns which tool is armed.

From the previous session and unchanged: SAM3 REPLACES SAM 1 AS THE REFINER but does NOT replace YOLO. SAM3 cannot enumerate (4 text categories already cost 10.5s), so it can never be the finder; YOLO cannot make a clean mask, so it can never be the refiner. Do not let a future session re-litigate this as SAM3 replaces everything.

git commit --only does NOT pick up UNTRACKED files - it silently commits nothing for them. New files (js/components/Organisms/MpiToolOptionsMaskBrush/, tests/mask-tool-registry.test.cjs, tasks/MPI-382/) need an explicit git add first.
Another session may be active on this board. Re-read board.json before mutating it. next_id is now 383.

THE BACKSLASH TRAP: card and event text is markdown inside a JSON string, so a lone backslash breaks the WHOLE BOARD, not just one card. Prefer the word backslash over the character, and validate every JSON and JSONL file after writing.
docs are capped at 200 lines each and docs/masking.md is now EXACTLY at 200. Anything new means trimming something first.
THE WORKFLOW CONVERTER HAS BLAST RADIUS. node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs with NO ARGUMENTS re-emits ALL 31 workflows and writes 15 stray template files. Always pass one explicit file path.
SAM3 TRAP 1: the text field parses category:N, comma separated. A bare category silently returns ONE detection. Any injection must always emit the :N form.
SAM3 TRAP 2: text and box prompts are mutually exclusive - in SAM3_Detect.execute the box branch is gated on not has_text.

SAM3 TRAP 3: SAM3 works at a fixed 1008x1008 internally then interpolates back up, while SAM 1 crops 1.8x around each box. Every measurement so far was on a 768x1376 image - test at 4K before declaring SAM 1 retired.
SAM3 TRAP 4: the point path ignores threshold entirely; only refine_iterations applies. That is why the Scope dial disappears.
IMPACT PACK DECIDES BBOX VS SEGM BY FOLDER, NOT FILENAME. A -seg model in ultralytics/bbox/ crashes with NO_SEGM_DETECTOR; it must live in ultralytics/segm/.
Leaving a mask tool MUST call setMaskPointsMode(false) or right-click stays broken app-wide.
MpiAutoMaskThumbs.setPicks() deliberately does NOT emit change - points mode relies on that silence. Do not fix it. MPI-379 deletes this component along with the thumb strip.
The thumbs DOM node is OWNED BY THE VIEWER. MpiMaskDetectRow re-parents it and DETACHES it in destroy - it must never destroy it.

Every new component registers its .css in js/shell/preloadStyles.js AND documents its props in js/components/types.js. MpiToolOptionsMaskBrush has NO css file by design, so it has no preloadStyles entry - that is deliberate, not an omission. Never modify js/components/factory.js (locked).
Frontend-only changes hot-reload with Ctrl+R. main.js, any .cjs and float-latent.html need a full restart.
Do not run git against sibling folders from this repo. Push stays a user-authorized live op.
